notes.title: Dev Blog #7: About Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are currently working on the early story of the game. Some images to explain the story, amulets as a new type of item, new NPCs and more will be added.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/3db58afa62fc9d3ced5effd4b998ee2cea5dc657.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/520d53999e8a3449102de723add84d55564d3e5a.jpg[/img]

It’ll take some time for the game to be updated because it requires time to prepare. The progress will be shared later again. 
 
Happy Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: V.0.6.2a Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]※NOT COMPATIBLE WITH OLDER SAVE FILES.[/b]

[h1]MAJOR[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a TUTORIAL. Select a NEW GAME or TUTORIAL in the MainMenu.
[*]Added a new Demon, Doorkeeper. 
[*]Added trap pits.
[*]Some hidden places are now more noticeable.
[*]Changed the default FoV setting. (90 => 110)
[/list]

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced required Essence to Level up early in the game.
[*]Reduced the amount of Essence from defeating some enemies.
[*]Reduced Attack Power of some weapons. (including the hatchet)
[*]Reduced Stamina cost of attacking with some weapons.
[*]Changed the attack animation of the pipe wrench and crowbar. (faster)
[*]Added “RLR” combo to the crowbar.
[*]Reduced the Morale level of the big Earthworms.
[*]Changed Ground Meat’s Life, Attack Power and the animation a little bit.
[*]Increased Fist Master’s Attack Power.
[/list]

[h1]MINOR[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a vendor to the corridor next to Ground Meat.
[*]Added Counter and Guard to the input guide on the HUD.
[*]Added decorations to Totem.
[*]Modified some Guide TV videos shorter.
[*]The Guide TV videos start over, when interacting.
[*]Fixed a bug with red eyes continued to exist when some enemies died.
[*]Changed some text in How to Play. (Guard left/right to Counterattack left/right)
[/list]

notes.title: V.0.5.6a Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed that enemies don’t respawn when restarting the game while using a bed or totem.
[*] Changed the attack move of the kitchen knife.
[*] Made the Backstab easier to execute.
[*] Added an animation to backstab sledgehammer workers.
[*] Added Field of View setting.
[*] Improved “reset to defaults” function in game settings.
[*] Added one more hint for hidden items to Worker’s Note.
[*] Deleted the word "fragile" from the box.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game crashes sometimes when leaving a bed or totem. This is still being investigated.
[*] Currently, only keyboard/mouse and Xbox 360 controller are fully supported.
[/list]
